ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white/light-grey pixels (approx. 90%) with localized low-intensity black pixel clusters (approx. 10%) primarily distributed along the edges and in focal interior regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast dark pigmentation mapping contiguous along the trailing edge boundary and distal tips; discrete low-intensity circular blobs located at [mid-ventral left lobe] and [inner-left lobe proximal to median notch].

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped median depression with an approximate pixel angle of 75 degrees and significant vertical depth into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration with irregular pixel-amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) along the entire continuous linear boundary of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature fitted to the outer trailing edges of both the left and right lobes, tapering towards distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of localized circular dark pixel clusters; one prominent large cluster on the left lobe and smaller clusters visible on the inner regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple prominent dark pigmentation spots on the ventral surface corresponding to previous colonization or traumatic scarring.
